name: desktop-appearance
description: Operator desktop appearance for a dome machine reached remotely: the dark Windows theme (per-user Personalize keys) and a dark background carrying the machine's identity -- hostname above all, plus site and role read from C:\WIS\config.toml. Written into the autologin 'mast' hive from the provisioning session, and re-asserted in that session by an AtLogon task, which is the only place a live desktop can be repainted.
